subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should WebChat get a configurable send-shortcut preference, and should that preference live in scoped browser-local UiSettings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or both?
rationale: The request is useful and aligned with Web frontend ergonomics, but adding or changing a persisted shortcut/default affects compatibility and settings ownership.

options.title: Review the linked PR path
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate, requiring compatibility-preserving defaults, scoped settings ownership, i18n copy, and tests for Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.

options.title: Limit to browser-local UI preference
options.body: Accept a scoped UiSettings preference only and avoid a new openclaw.json operator config unless centralized policy is explicitly desired.

options.title: Decline the setting
options.body: Keep the current Enter-to-send plus Shift+Enter newline contract and close the linked PR and this issue as not planned.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR path
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/73390 as the implementation candidate, requiring compatibility-preserving defaults, scoped settings ownership, i18n copy, and tests for Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history and prior review context across the WebChat/settings decision surface.
